identity_findings.counter_evidence: Kalshi market tickers name the same slots 'WBT Academy' (e.g. kxcs2game-26oct150400eacwbtacademy); bo3.gg, egamersworld and strafe.com publish a 'WROTBERRY' roster (fl1peR / svemyy / aRTYSAN / tired73 / lyoli) matching Valve's 'WBT Academy' row (standing 130, 911 points). The two candidate rosters imply opposite picks on WROTBERRY vs EAC, so the conflict is published rather than settled.
identity_findings.confidence: resolved by roster identity (HLTV lineup == Valve WBT row), contested by exchange labelling
